digest:
- Commercial auto liability's decade-long lack of underwriting profit is driving fleets toward captives, presenting an opportunity for Nirvana's disciplined telematics underwriting as an alternative to traditional rate hikes [1].
- Officials are rallying behind new legislation targeting last-mile delivery facilities with environmental and operational restrictions, requiring Nirvana to monitor urban route and risk profile changes [2].
- Banyan Risk is expanding its Bermuda casualty platform into the US E&S market backed by Accredited capacity, introducing new specialty capacity that may create competitive pricing pressure [10].
